module_summary: AXI-Lite write crossbar: per-slave address decoders and response-routing FIFOs, per-master round-robin AW arbiters with write-data routing and B-select FIFOs, joined by valid/ready matrices with register slices on both sides.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].a_select
anchors.why: Decoded master index for slave write address; routes avalid into the crossbar matrix.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant
anchors.why: Per-master one-hot round-robin grant among requesting slaves; gates request and acknowledge.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_select
anchors.why: Per-slave FIFO of outstanding write master selects used to route B responses.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant selects winning slave's awaddr/awprot/awvalid into the master register slice.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_reg
anchors.why: Master-side write data mux select, latched from arbitration grant per transaction.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_select_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side destination master for write data, from address decoder write command.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_drop_reg
anchors.why: Decode-error drop flag: accepts and discards slave write data instead of forwarding.

anchors.name: int_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave-by-master AW valid matrix feeding per-master arbiter requests.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].b_select
anchors.why: FIFO-head master index selecting which master's B response returns to slave.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_select
anchors.why: Per-master FIFO of granted slave indices routing B responses back.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valid into slave-side register slices.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Master write-address valid from master-side register slices.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Slave response FIFO write pointer, advanced on response command.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Slave response FIFO read pointer, advanced when head entry is prefetched.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_decerr
anchors.why: Per-entry decode-error flags producing DECERR B responses.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Admission control: blocks new response commands when FIFO half full.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].fifo_rd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Valid flag of prefetched FIFO head driving b_valid.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].b_decerr
anchors.why: Forces DECERR bresp and local bvalid for unmapped writes.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].w_select_valid_reg
anchors.why: Write data route valid; gates wvalid forwarding and m_wc_ready.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_wc_valid
anchors.why: Write command valid from address decoder loading write route.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Response command valid writing the response routing FIFO.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid; qualifies muxed awvalid and write route loading.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_request
anchors.why: Arbiter requests gated by FIFO half-full and pending write route.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_valid_reg
anchors.why: Master write data route valid; gates wvalid mux and wready return.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].w_select_new_reg
anchors.why: Ensures write route loads once per new arbitration grant.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Master B-routing FIFO write pointer, advanced on AW accept.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Master B-routing FIFO read pointer, advanced on B handshake.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Limits outstanding writes per master by blocking arbiter requests.

anchors.name: int_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave-by-master W valid matrix steered by slave write route.

anchors.name: int_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Master-by-slave B valid matrix steered by master b_select.

groups.name: slave_addr_decode
groups.description: Per-slave address decoder issuing master select, write command and response command.

groups.name: slave_response_fifo
groups.description: Per-slave FIFO of master selects and decode errors steering B response mux.

groups.name: slave_write_routing
groups.description: Holds destination master or drop for the current slave write data beat.

groups.name: master_aw_arbiter
groups.description: Per-master round-robin arbiter and address mux among slaves.

groups.name: master_write_routing
groups.description: Latches granted slave to mux its write data into the master.

groups.name: master_b_fifo
groups.description: Per-master FIFO of slave indices routing B responses back.

groups.name: crossbar_matrix
groups.description: Valid/ready interconnect matrices between slave and master sides.

groups.name: register_slices
groups.description: Slave- and master-side AXI-Lite write register slices.
